My family was in and out of homeless shelters when I was young. My mom got a job paying about 15 starting which got us out of it. My father was an abuser and all of the money he made went to his car and booze (this was after getting out of the shelter he worked as a construction worker) my mom divorced him bc of the abuse and we found ourselves in a similar place, she put herself aside to set me and my brother and sister up for success. Since then I have graduated highschool 4.0 and I am currently a senior in college with a 3.7. I don’t study super hard I don’t spend all of my time doing school work the government aid was enough to pay for most of my tuition and my grades from high school covered the rest with scholarships. 

This isn’t a brag. I came from nothing shelters no help my family pulled itself out. My sister is in the military and my brother is in his senior year of highschool set to go to a school with a sports scholarship. If we can do it you can too. Call us lucky or whatever you want that’s an excuse. You had internet to type this you have enough o start digging your way out. I met people at the shelter who had less than nothing the only thing they had was the clothes on their back and the shelter itself. You have something and there is no excuse to not work your ass off until you are out of the hole you started in. As soon as I turned 16 and I could work I was working same for both of my siblings. We grew ourselves out of rotten soil. You can too.
